description:
Meet Tomo, a little blob who only speaks Japanese, and only as much as a real child its age.

Your Tomo hatches from an egg the first time you open the app, and no one else's looks quite like it. At 1 year old it says single baby words like ワンワン and バイバイ. Show it you understood: tap the right picture, do what it asks (feed it, put it to bed, give it a hug), or pick what a word means. There's nothing to type and nothing to say out loud. Tomo says every word for you in Japanese.

Every word you understand helps Tomo grow. It levels up as its words stick, and at each birthday it evolves into a new shape. At 2 it uses two-word phrases, and from 3 it asks you real questions.

A FEW MINUTES A DAY
Tomodachi isn't for cramming. Each word comes back just before you'd forget it: first after a few hours, then days, then weeks. When nothing is due, Tomo rests and tells you when it's back. You can keep practicing, but only answers at the right time move the bar. Growing up takes weeks and months, like a real child.

TOMO COMES TO YOU
• A short first run hatches your Tomo, teaches your first word, and asks how often Tomo may find you.
• Reminders when words are ready, at the rhythm you pick (every 15 minutes to once a day), never in your quiet hours. Ignore them and they slow down. No streaks, no guilt.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show Tomo and what's waiting.
• If you like, Tomo waits on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Tap Play to answer a word right there.

WATCH IT GROW
• Play: Tomo, big and alive, with its experience bar and how many words are left to the next level.
• Tomo: its age and level, what each age brings, and what you did today.
• Words: every level, with each word's picture, reading, meaning, stage and when it comes back.
• Tap what Tomo says to see how it's read and what it means, or look a word up in the iPhone's dictionary.

THE WORDS
Tomo's words come from research on the words Japanese children understand and say first, in the order they learn them, from baby talk up to six-year-old vocabulary. Meanings come with the app, and the iPhone's dictionary is a tap away.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking and no AI. Everything Tomo teaches is in the app, so it works offline. Your progress stays in your own iCloud, so your Tomo is still there on a new iPhone. We run no servers and collect no data.

Tomodachi teaches Japanese to English speakers.
promotionalText: Hatch a little blob who only speaks Japanese, like a real 1-year-old. Understand its words and watch it grow up, a few minutes a day.
reviewNotes:
No sign-in or account is needed. This version teaches Japanese to English speakers; everything it teaches is bundled with the app.

FIRST RUN (about 2 minutes): tap "Hatch it", then answer Tomo's first word by tapping the picture that matches (a coach mark shows how). Next it explains how Tomo comes to you and asks for a reminder rhythm and quiet hours. Notifications and Tomo's Lock Screen card are both optional: each is asked once, on its own screen that first says why, with "Not now" to skip. The widget how-to can be skipped with "I'll do this later".

TABS (bottom of the screen): Play (answer Tomo's words), Tomo (age, level, experience bar, what each age brings, today), Words (every word with its stage and when it comes back) and Settings (reminders, quiet hours, the Lock Screen card, new words a day, sound, start over). About, with the privacy policy, support and credits, is the last row of Settings.

SPACED REVIEW IS BY DESIGN: after a few answers Tomo rests and says when it's back ("Back at 10:12") and what's left to the next level. This is not a dead end: words come back after hours, then days, as in any spaced-repetition app. Practice stays available on the resting screen but doesn't move the bar. To see progress, open the Tomo and Words tabs.

WIDGETS AND LIVE ACTIVITY: Home Screen widgets (small, medium) and Lock Screen widgets show Tomo and how many words are waiting. If you said yes to the Lock Screen card, a Live Activity shows Tomo on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island; its yellow Play button answers one word right on the card.

SOUND: Tomo speaks with the iPhone's Japanese voice. The Ring/Silent switch mutes it, as in a game.

PRIVACY: progress syncs between the learner's own devices (another iPhone, or the Tomodachi Mac app, now in beta) through their private iCloud database (CloudKit). There are no servers of ours, no other network requests (links in About and "Open in Zenbu" open the website in Safari), and no data collected.
